headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates cruised past the Miami Marlins in a dominant 13-1 victory, with Rafael Flores Jr. collecting 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. The Seattle Mariners placed shortstop Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox placed right-hander Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants transferred third baseman Matt Chapman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The Boston Red Sox placed right-hander Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers placed center fielder James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed catcher Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with left hip inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have been announced. The Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles. The Miami Marlins traded first baseman Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge White Sox in Thrilling 9-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a hard-fought 9-8 win over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out three batters in a scoreless inning.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki had a notable performance for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Colt Emerson on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
